Design.evidence_source: First, we replicate the HC and HCT conditions with 51 and 52 subjects, respectively. [page/12/Text/4] In the "reversed hidden consequences" (RHC) and "reversed hidden consequences with time pressure" (RHCT) conditions, we have 66 and 63 subjects, respectively. [page/12/Text/5]

country.evidence_source: A total of 232 UK participants were invited to take part in our study via Prolific [page/12/Text/3]

info_cost.evidence_source: participants received a £1 showup fee and bonus payments according to the decisions made in the study. Game payoffs were expressed in points and then translated into £ at a rate of £0.5 per point. [page/12/Text/3]
